desc:
👋 Welcome to Steal an Entity Egg! 

🥚 HOW TO PLAY
🏃 Sneak into a biome and steal an egg from a sleeping guardian
😱 It wakes up! Run back to the safe zone before it catches you
🐣 Place your egg in your pen, wait for it to grow, then hatch it
💰 Your pets make money every second, even while you're offline!

⚡ Run on your treadmill to get faster and reach scarier biomes
👻 12 spooky biomes: Pumpkin Patch to The Void
🦴 Over 150 creepy pets, from Common to Divine
👹 10 guardians inspired by creepypastas: Siren Head, the Rake, the Hat Man, Wendigo and more
🥷 Steal eggs from other players' pens, and smack them with your bat to make them drop theirs
✨ Find Huge, Giant and Colossal eggs and rare mutations
📖 Fill your Index to claim Speed and cash rewards

🎁 Claim your FREE gift in the spawn!
👥 Play with friends for +10% money each

👍 Like and ⭐ favourite the game for updates!
